prompt: Someone says a bus route is unreliable because it was late on one trip. Explain what additional observations would help evaluate that claim. A response of around 80 words is enough.
text: One late trip is only anecdotal. Useful observations include arrival times across many trips, different days and times of day, traffic and weather conditions, route segments, and whether delays were isolated or recurring. Compare actual times with the published schedule, calculate how often buses are late and by how much, and contrast results with similar routes. A consistent pattern of substantial delays would support the claim; an occasional delay would not.
